h2: Bring the Royal Feast to Your Venue
p: A journey of passion, heritage, and timeless artistry written one plate at a time.

he Rahamatullah brand began its journey in 1998, founded by Mahboob A. Aziz Tahasildar. His vision was clear from day one: to create a symbol of quality and taste that honors the legacy of authentic cuisine.

Synonymous with the legacy of Tandoor and Mughlai cuisine, we bring the feel of the royal era to your dining experience. Our chefs master the art of original spices and saffron to create dishes that feel like a journey through history.

Under the name "Qaswa Hills," we expanded our branches to Maharashtra and Karnataka, including Miraj, Kolhapur, Sangli, and Bijapur. This marked a new chapter, bringing our unique Mughlai flavors to a wider audience.

Today, the next generation of dynamic leaders follows the founder's strict discipline of quality. From our famous Biryani to our grilled Kebabs, we promise consistent taste, fresh ingredients, and the same exceptional hospitality we started with.
